data.body:
Decision (2026-10-25 18:40 PDT): fold the flat form into TID253 and keep a residual AST test for the nested forms only. This replaces patchset 2's full deletion of the heavy scan and answers plan-review findings G6 (equivalence) and E4 (unused imports).

Why: ruff 0.16.3 cannot express the nested forms. Source at tag 0.16.3: `crates/ruff_linter/src/rules/flake8_tidy_imports/rules/banned_module_level_imports.rs` starts with `if !checker.semantic().at_top_level() { return; }`, and `ruff_python_semantic/src/model.rs:1806-1810` defines `at_top_level` as `scope_id.is_global() && current_statement_parent_id().is_none()`. There is no setting for this. Issue search on astral-sh/ruff for TID253 found no open request covering nested module-level imports (closest: #12803, #19423, #17118).

Existing-gate check: `scripts/check_import_walk.py` runs only in the CI artifact probe, on a clean wheel without extras. Measured by running its `walk_package` over a scratch package with the heavy stack blocked, it catches 9 of 16 cases (top-level, try body without a swallowing except, except taken, finally, if taken, with, for that runs, while that runs, match hit). It misses the guarded `try: import httpx` / `except ImportError: httpx = None` idiom, except-not-taken, else-not-taken, for over an empty iterable, while False, TYPE_CHECKING and in-function imports. `test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack` loads 212 rebar modules of 654 outside `_engine`. The current tree has 0 nested heavy imports outside `_engine` (AST census).

Equivalence, 20 forms. Columns: deleted scan, ruff TID253 (`--output-format json`), residual draft, and ruff plus residual.
```
in_class                 old=-    ruff=-    residual=-    both=-    match
in_function              old=-    ruff=-    residual=-    both=-    match
in_method                old=-    ruff=-    residual=-    both=-    match
light_import             old=-    ruff=-    residual=-    both=-    match
module_except_body       old=FIRE ruff=-    residual=FIRE both=FIRE match
module_finally           old=FIRE ruff=-    residual=FIRE both=FIRE match
module_for               old=FIRE ruff=-    residual=FIRE both=FIRE match
module_if                old=FIRE ruff=-    residual=FIRE both=FIRE match
module_if_else           old=FIRE ruff=-    residual=FIRE both=FIRE match
module_match             old=FIRE ruff=-    residual=FIRE both=FIRE match
module_try               old=FIRE ruff=-    residual=FIRE both=FIRE match
module_while             old=FIRE ruff=-    residual=FIRE both=FIRE match
module_with              old=FIRE ruff=-    residual=FIRE both=FIRE match
submodule_from           old=FIRE ruff=FIRE residual=-    both=FIRE match
submodule_from_dotted    old=FIRE ruff=FIRE residual=-    both=FIRE match
submodule_import         old=FIRE ruff=FIRE residual=-    both=FIRE match
top_from                 old=FIRE ruff=FIRE residual=-    both=FIRE match
top_import               old=FIRE ruff=FIRE residual=-    both=FIRE match
top_import_as            old=FIRE ruff=FIRE residual=-    both=FIRE match
type_checking            old=FIRE ruff=-    residual=FIRE both=FIRE match
forms=20 mismatches=0 double-flagged=0
```
The TID251 recheck on ruff 0.16.3 matched the expected table on all 17 forms (fires on 11, including nested_try, nested_if, type_checking, in_function and in_class; silent on relative imports, similar names and attribute use).

The TYPE_CHECKING case stays flagged, as in the deleted scan, so the contract is unchanged. `ast.TryStar` is not a subclass of `ast.Try`, so the deleted scan never entered `try*`; the residual adds it. `_OPTIONALITY_SUITE_ITEM_COUNT` stays 10, so `test_ci_workflow_parity.py` leaves file_impact and `test_ruff_ratchet.py` joins it.

Rejected: folding only TID251 (it leaves the flat half duplicated and narrows the story); accepting the narrower TID253 (it leaves the guarded-import idiom with no oracle in 442 modules).
